name: Vextorium

overview.text: Vextorium presents 244 pay-per-call data services across ten sectors, including public economic data, crypto and FX, Spanish records, compliance checks and local AI text tools. It lists $0.001 to $0.02 calls and says failed requests are not settled. Payment routes differ: x402 uses USDC on six networks or RLUSD/XRP on XRP Ledger, while MPP uses USDC.e/OUSD on Tempo; MCP call_service is described as USDC through x402. A free date-tool and catalog walkthrough is separate from paid data calls. Linking-site badges are listed references, not verified endorsements, and local AI outputs are information rather than investment advice.
